commission_templates.description: Commission template for the Demo client. Payees resolve to agents and entities in Demo settings.
commission_templates.eligibility_formula: AND(OR(transaction_status = "Pending", transaction_status = "Closed"), closing_date <> "", agent_id <> "", total_commission > 0, OR(lead_source <> "", custom_commission_splits <> ""))

commission_template_parameters.autofill_formula:
IF(
	OR(property_address="", closing_date=""), 
		100%, 
		IF(
			COUNTIFS(property_address, property_address, closing_date, closing_date, transaction_side, "<>"&transaction_side)>0, 
			50%, 
			100%))

IF(
	AND(
		ISNUMBER(SEARCH(": ", custom_referral)), 
		ISNUMBER(SEARCH("$", TRIM(TEXTAFTER(custom_referral, ": "))))
	), 
		NUMBERVALUE(
			SUBSTITUTE(
				SUBSTITUTE(
					TRIM(
						TEXTAFTER(custom_referral, ": ")), "$", ""), ",", "")), 
		"")

IF(
	XLOOKUP(agent_id, agents.id, agents.is_team_lead) = TRUE,
	custom_tc_fee,
	""
)

IF(
  AND(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("%", custom_referral)), ISNUMBER(SEARCH(": ", custom_referral))),
  NUMBERVALUE(SUBSTITUTE(TRIM(TEXTAFTER(custom_referral, ": ")), "%", "")),
  IF(
    AND(lead_source="Zillow Flex", NOT(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("$", custom_referral)))),
    IF(sales_price>=500000, 40%,
      IF(sales_price>=375000, 35%,
        IF(sales_price>=250000, 30%,
          IF(sales_price>=125000, 25%, 15%)))),
    ""
  )
)

IF(
	custom_commission_splits = "",
	"",
	IF(
		ISNUMBER(SEARCH(": ", custom_commission_splits)),
		IF(
			AND(
				TEXTBEFORE(custom_commission_splits, ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
				XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(custom_commission_splits, ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
			),
			IF(
				ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" | ", custom_commission_splits)),
				IF(
					AND(
						TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
						XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
					),
					TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": "),
					IF(
						ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" | ", TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "))),
						IF(
							AND(
								TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
								XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
							),
							TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": "),
							""
						),
						""
					)
				),
				""
			),
			IF(
				ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" | ", custom_commission_splits)),
				IF(
					AND(
						TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
						XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
					),
					IF(
						ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" | ", TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "))),
						IF(
							AND(
								TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
								XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
							),
							TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": "),
							""
						),
						""
					),
					""
				),
				""
			)
		),
		""
	)
)
IF(XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.is_team_lead)=TRUE, "", XLOOKUP(TRUE, agents.is_team_lead, agents.agent_name))

IF(
	custom_commission_splits = "",
	"",
	IF(
		ISNUMBER(SEARCH(": ", custom_commission_splits)),
		IF(
			AND(
				TEXTBEFORE(custom_commission_splits, ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
				XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(custom_commission_splits, ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
			),
			TEXTBEFORE(custom_commission_splits, ": "),
			IF(
				ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" | ", custom_commission_splits)),
				IF(
					AND(
						TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
						XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
					),
					TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), ": "),
					IF(
						ISNUMBER(SEARCH(" | ", TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "))),
						IF(
							AND(
								TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": ") <> XLOOKUP(agent_1, agents.id, agents.agent_name),
								XLOOKUP(TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": "), agents.agent_name, agents.is_team_lead) <> TRUE
							),
							TEXTBEFORE(TEXTAFTER(TEXTAFTER(custom_commission_splits, " | "), " | "), ": "),
							""
						),
						""
					)
				),
				""
			)
		),
		""
	)
)
